title: Teacher downloads
signedOut: Open Teacher and sign in when you are connected to see your downloads.
empty: This account has no downloads available on this device. Download a lesson from Teacher when you are connected.
missing: The requested copy is unavailable to this account.
unavailable: Downloads could not be opened. Go back to Teacher when connected to check your access.
denied: This account no longer has access to the requested material.
renewSession: Your session has expired. Open Teacher when connected to renew it and view the copy.
delete_failed: The download could not be deleted. Try again.
newer: Teacher has a newer version. Open the online lesson to update your copy.

progress.saved: You have a saved reading point.
progress.pending: Point saved on this device. Waiting to sync.
progress.uncertain: The reading point submission still needs confirmation.
progress.conflict: Another device changed the reading point.
progress.pendingElsewhere: A reading point is pending in another copy of this plan.
progress.outdated: The material changed. Download the lesson again before marking another point.
progress.unavailable: Teacher cannot apply this point in the plan's current state.
progress.failed: The reading point on this device could not be updated.
